name: footsteps
purpose: Plays count footstep sounds (ROOT play_footstep_sound) each followed by animate_wait(2). Ghidra named it NPC_a290 (NPC/FLAMES/COMBAT... share the address; vectors 02f6/057e/05f6/07b2 target those overlays).

name: decode_move_code
purpose: Move-script byte decoder: code & 0xfc selects the monster slot (0x10->6, 0x14->7, 0x18->8, 0x1c->0, 0x20->1; otherwise the result is uninitialised), code & 3 sets g_dx/g_dy: 0 N (dy=-1), 1 E (dx=1), 2 S (dy=1), 3 W (dx=-1). Returns the slot.
notes: return value uninitialised for unknown codes; port returns 0.

name: run_move_script
purpose: Byte-code interpreter for the cut-scene scripts at DGROUP 0x369e, 0x36da, 0x3702, 0x370e, 0x3716. Opcodes: 0 end; 1 pair mode (next move code is followed by a second slot's code); 2 n repeat count; 3 footsteps on; 4 off; 5 n animate_wait(n); 6 v x y g_light_map[y][x] = v; 7 refresh_map_view; 8 footsteps(count), count = 1; 9 s clear tile/anim tile of slot s; >= 0x10 move code: decode_move_code, then count times add (dx,dy) to the slot's x/y (and the pair slot's), one footstep per step while enabled. Count (1) and pair mode reset after each move; the footstep flag persists.

name: print_interrogation_question
proto: void print_interrogation_question(int virtue, int round)  /* Ghidra (param_1=virtue, param_2=round) */
purpose: Round 0/1/2 print MISCMSG.DAT text (loaded at 0xb21e) 0xb21e / 0xb24b / 0xb270, the virtue name g_virtue_mantra_ptrs[virtue] and '?"'; round 3 prints 0xb2ca; then the empty a576.

name: fn_1000_a558
purpose: Not a function: the round == 2 arm of print_interrogation_question. Vector 1778:0452 targets OUTSUBS's a558 (scroll_map_chunks), not this overlay. No-op in the port.

name: nop_after_question
purpose: Empty function (just RET) called after every question.

name: response_contains_mantra
purpose: Prints 'Your response?', read_text_line(14 chars), blank line; returns 1 if the mantra g_virtue_mantra_ptrs[8+virtue] (0x1f5e) occurs case-insensitively (to_upper) at any offset of the answer, else 0.

name: execute_prisoner
purpose: Prints MISCMSG 0xb34b (sliced == 0) or 0xb30f, animate_wait(10), rising (2000..24950 step 50) and falling sweeps play_sweep_noise(0,f,200,1,0xa50), flash_tile_at(slot1 y, slot1 x), clears slot 1 tiles, g_light_map[7][5] = 0x80. Victim = index of the second living member (party count if none). Its 32-byte record is copied out, records after it shifted down by one (up to record 15), the copy stored as record 15 with +0x1f = 0x7f, g_party_count--, draw_status_window. sliced != 0: '<name> is sliced in half!', key, 0xb3be. put_char(10).

0xadf9.name: g_light_map
0xadf9.meaning: [7][5]: the cut-scene room tile drawn there

name: script_release
purpose: read_command_key then run_move_script(0x369e) (the guards release the party).

name: script_threaten_companion
purpose: Prints MISCMSG 0xb447, run_move_script(0x36da), 0xb47d, the name of party record 1 (0x55c8), ' die!" ', waits for a key, blank line.

name: interrogation
proto: void interrogation(int living, int virtue)  /* Ghidra (param_1=living, param_2=virtue) */
purpose: Four rounds: print_interrogation_question(virtue, round); a correct mantra (response_contains_mantra) sets g_shrine_destroyed[virtue] = 0xff, karma -= 5, execute_prisoner(0) when living > 1 else prints 0xb4ba, script_release, return. Wrong with living < 2: 0xb4fa, script_release, return. Otherwise first refusal: script_threaten_companion; later refusals: pass_time(2), draw_status_window, g_light_map[9][5] = 0xea/0xeb/0xe8 for rounds 0/1/2, execute_prisoner(1) at round 3. Returns after round 3.

name: blackthorn_dungeon_scene
purpose: Vector 1778:033e (TOWN guard_arrest in Castle Blackthorn). Counts living members; transport 0x1c; refresh; 'Thou art subdued and blindfolded!'; virtue = first index with g_shrine_destroyed == 0 (all betrayed -> skip to the end). Blank window (set_color 0, fill_rect 0xb7,0xb7,8,8), z = 0xff, sky strip, wind, 5 footsteps (wait_ticks 5), 'Strong guards drag thee away!', 18 (sound off: 3) more, monster table cleared, g_location = g_active_combatant = 0xff, MISCMAPS.DAT bytes 0..0xb0 -> g_view_objects then copied as 11 rows of 11 bytes into g_light_map (stride 0x20), MISCMSG.DAT 1000 bytes -> 0xb21e. Members 0..living-1 placed in slots 0.. at seats: index = 0x1f0a[living*8+i], x = 0x1f42[index], y = 0x1f48[index], tile = 0x1ade[str_index_of(class, "AMBFDTPRS")]. 'chained and manacled!', 'Footsteps!', footsteps(8), guards 0x70 in slots 6 (10,4) and 7 (10,6), script 0x3702, sweep, Blackthorn slot 8 at (5,5): tile 0x16, tile_transition_effect(5,5,0x178), tile 0x78; 'Blackthorn says: Ah, <avatar>! ...', key, 'GUARD! Release this good' + ' lady '/'man ' by gender byte 0x55b1 (0xc/0xb) + 'at once!', script 0x370e, 0xb54a, key, interrogation(living, virtue); if slot 8 still has a tile, script 0x3716. End: z = 0xff, sky, wind, party (10,7), g_keys = 0, g_location = 0x12.

name: resurrection_scene
purpose: Vector 1778:02de (TOWN/MAINOUT loops when everybody is dead). select_disk(1), loop until file_exists('BRIT.DAT'); CAST2 eaca(g_light_spell_turns); transport 0x1e; refresh if location < 0x21; wait 10; old = g_location; g_location = g_active_combatant = 0xff; 'An unending darkness engulfs thee...'; window blacked through page 1 + rect_effect; g_light_map rows 0..10 (11 bytes) = 0xff; slots cleared; refresh; 'Thou hast found refuge.' (wait 14) 'No evil lives here...' (wait 28) 'But thy slumber is disturbed!'; g_combat_map_centre = 0, party slot tile 0x1c at (5,5); six play_sweep_noise(step 0x3744[i], threshold 0x3738[i], count 0x372c[i], 1, phase 0x3720[i]); 'Someone shouts FORTIS FORTUNA AVENTARI'; sparkle slot 1 tile 0x16 at (2,7): g_light_map[7][2] = 0 then tile_transition_effect(7,2,0x5e) and = 0x5e; same at (8,7) with 0x5f into [7][8]; 'There is a peal of thunder!', earthquake_shake x2, [2][5] = 0, Lord British: slot 1 at (5,2) tile 0x16 -> transition 0x174 -> 0x74; KARMA.DAT paragraph at word 0x1a74[karma/20] (2000 bytes into 0xb21e) printed between quotes, key; 'Strange words are intoned.'; per member: sweep (2, 2000, 0x7530, 1, 0x8e30/(i+7)), CAST2 e7c0(0xff, i), HP = max HP, status redraw; 'Vertigo...'; window replaced via page 1 with draw_tile(5,5,0x11c) + rect_effect; karma >= 75; g_location = 0x11, z = 1, on foot, (10,10), protection 0, status icon 0, pass_time(9) until 06:00, light/torch 0, food >= 63; if old was a settlement enter_town(1).
